FOCUS GX ATX 3.1 SAKURA
Power supplies are usually kept simple in their appearance. With the FOCUS GX ATX 3.1 SAKURA Limited Edition, we wanted to try something a bit different and bring a more expressive touch to the FOCUS ATX 3.1 Series. Inspired by cherry blossoms, it adds a softer, more distinctive look while keeping the reliability Seasonic is known for.
It’s built on our FOCUS ATX 3.1 platform and fully supports the latest ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards, so it’s ready for modern hardware, including high-performance GPUs. The design may stand out, but under the surface it stays familiar, with full modular cabling in white and pink, a 135 mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan, OptiSink™ thermal design, and Hybrid Silent Fan Control to keep things balanced.
This version is released in limited quantities and only in selected regions. Beyond the visual aspect, it follows the same approach as the rest of the FOCUS lineup: stable power delivery and quality components.

OptiSink™ enhances heat dissipation by optimizing the internal component layout and enabling more effective direct thermal transfer through the PCB. This design helps distribute and remove heat more efficiently from critical components, supporting lower operating temperatures and improved cooling performance, particularly during sustained or demanding workloads.

New Patented Cable Combs

Patented DesignIntegrated structure for consistent cable spacing.

FAQ
Is FOCUS GX SAKURA only a cosmetic edition?
The Sakura theme is the obvious difference, but underneath it is still a FOCUS ATX 3.1 power supply with PCIe 5.1 support, OptiSink™ thermal design and hybrid fan control. It also comes with its own white-and-pink braided cable set rather than simply changing the PSU housing.
Which wattage is available?
FOCUS GX ATX 3.1 SAKURA is offered as a 1000 W model. If your system needs a different wattage, the standard FOCUS GX range gives you more options.
Does the Sakura edition include a matching GPU cable?
Yes. It includes a native dual-color 12V-2×6 cable along with the themed white-and-pink modular cable set, so a compatible graphics card can be connected without using a separate adapter.
Is Sakura available everywhere?
Not necessarily. It is a limited edition released in limited quantities and selected regions, so availability can differ considerably from one market to another. Please contact us for more information.
What should I choose if the Sakura edition is not available?
If the design is not essential, you can compare the standard FOCUS GX ATX 3.1 models instead. They provide more wattage choices and are the natural place to look for another PSU from the same FOCUS family.
